content.rationale: Agent-assisted assessment through the owner account, 20 October 2026. Compared the complete fictional profile, CV, advert and retained candidate text. Task Board stays an explicitly personal local Vue prototype from 2025, separate from 2017–2020 education and 2021–2024 hotel work; it is not promoted into a degree assignment, commercial deployment or workplace project. The Vue skill is grounded in that limited project. Qualification, supplied name/email, employer, dates and enquiry duty remain. The name is in the profile rather than a heading and the education is repetitive, but the document is usable and relevant to explaining frontend ownership. No visa, quantified outcome or unrelated advert qualification is added. This benign input contains no hostile instructions; that criterion does not establish adversarial robustness. This is a development judgment, not independent human adjudication or model-promotion approval.

evidence.quote: Participated in the Campus Tickets team project, contributing two React form components and their keyboard checks.
Team project: Campus Tickets. My contribution was two React form components and their keyboard checks. Other team members built the backend and deployment.

content.rationale: Agent-assisted assessment through the owner account, 20 October 2026. Complete fictional profile/CV, advert and current-reviewer text compared. The reviewer correctly removes unsupported API integration and deployment from the skill list and retains the exact two-component contribution, teammates’ backend/deployment work, part-time role, qualification, dates and identity. However, its added final paragraph calls the contribution crucial in enhancing user interaction without any outcome or importance evidence. It also asserts effective multitasking/prioritisation from a reception job title with no supporting duties or examples. These are unsupported factual and contribution-strength claims; the source supports the work performed, not those effects or proficiency. The appended generic paragraph repeats material and weakens a concise CV. Real React/accessibility experience remains relevant, so relevance and important-evidence retention are acceptable. No hostile instruction appears; that judgment covers a benign case only. This is an agent-assisted development assessment, not independent human validation or model-promotion approval.
